the smart home field should focus on the development of meaningful technologies, on designing for the complexity of domestic spaces, and on human-home collaboration.
smart homes should be designed to be more meaningful to their users, more complex in terms of their functionality, and more collaborative in terms of their interactions with people.

the question of how we can design and build smart homes that offer a better fit with our everyday lives.
the design of smart homes that are more meaningful to their inhabitants, that are more responsive to the complexity of domestic life, and that can better support human-home collaboration.
the development of homes that support the people who live in them.

smart homes are still far away from the visions that were set for them in the 1990s.

we envision homes that are more than just a collection of technologies.
we need to move away from a focus on the home and towards a focus on the person, and from a focus on technology to a focus on the human.
